plan.name: Attribute Go acceptance compiler failures
plan.summary: Complete issue #604 in one plumbing change: the explicitly configured Go lifecycle may qualify a completed compiler failure only when trusted analysis of the unchanged, included acceptance and the normally compiled package attributes a proposed production API use to that exact selector; diagnostics, exit codes, shared helpers, ambiguous children and other selectors supply no such authority. Add conservative attribution using the prepared toolchain and ordinary production files and dependencies under captured flags, with host-owned helpers and completed process observations; retain compile/failed evidence, its attribution and full invocation/source/execution binding in an optional TestResult.evidence report, validate it before qualification, continue independent base selectors, and require fresh authentic runtime passes and all applicable commands on candidates. Preserve existing discovery-only and standalone runtime refusal contracts, Run/ReadFile/Close-only and trusted-evidence environments, every existing acceptance_*, go_*, native_* and other test and fake unchanged, existing deadlines and cleanup, disabled default adapters/configured planning/external plumbing, and the unconfigured Go path; new default real-Go fixtures cover correction, independent selectors, setup and ambiguity, authority and stale evidence, real compilation interruption and consumed shared allowance through checkRepositoryBase and Sandbox.Run, including the prepared Docker transport's daemon-free boundary. Update SPEC.md, docs/factory.md and the README's short status paragraph to describe this configured attribution boundary and its conservative refusals, citing the issue's existing decisions and preserving the README's 400-line limit; the merger records the attribution refinement of D-0316 and D-0321 because plumbing cannot write decisions, with unavailable Docker/network checks as Merger work and affected real Python/TLAPS suites still required in CI. Run the new acceptance and the existing plumbing suites, including all earlier runtime, corruption, transport and lifecycle fixtures, without weakening or replacing their assertions.

tests.name: TestGoCompilerProductionCorrection604
tests.says: A real missing production API yields exact bound compile/failed base evidence; identical acceptance bytes pass only after a production-only fix and fresh runtime execution, including captured build policy and external tests.

tests.name: TestGoCompilerIndependentSelectors604
tests.says: Each selector has its own failure and fresh invocation; compile failures never qualify a passing neighbor in the same file or package, a shared helper's callers, ambiguous children, or the same name in another package, module or part.

tests.name: TestGoCompilerSetupRefusals604
tests.says: After an attributable compile control, missing tools, unresolved imports, broken discovery, wrong or excluded declarations, unrelated invalid test or production source, and transport errors yield explained non-evidence while earlier runtime results survive.

tests.name: TestGoCompilerAuthorityAndFreshness604
tests.says: Compile evidence survives JSON and clipping with exact bindings, rejects mismatched and stale records, and configured checks and queue registration retain captured authority through candidate and caller changes; absent or unsupported adapters refuse before preparation.

tests.name: TestGoCompilerLifetime604
tests.says: Real preceding work reduces later selectors' shared allowance; cancellation during an observed real compiler process produces no compile or test completion and preserves earlier results and bounded cleanup.

tests.name: TestGoCompilerPreparedDocker604
tests.says: The production prepared Docker process boundary, replacing only Docker in a mandatory daemon-free fixture, attributes base compilation and obtains a fresh candidate runtime pass without changing acceptance bytes.

usage.summary: Wrote [plan.json](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-plan-1915891866/plan.json) and six acceptance tests covering the complete #604 plumbing change. The final check passed: all six tests fail on the base as required, and `repo/` remains unchanged.
